question:
The bar graph shows the total production and export of computers (in thousands) by a company in three years. Find the average export by the company in the given years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc8a7e9e0231d6022cf9d0439eec6281be4adc316aac1b29ca0ef2a46c292110.png]
solution:
**Solution:**

Total number of export by the company in the given years = 11000 + 14000 + 5000 = 30000

Average = Total export/Number of export year

⇒ 30000/3 = 10000

 

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
